terms.title: Inhloso
terms.body: Leli dokhumenti lethula isakhiwo sesikhashana semigomo yokusetshenziswa ye-AWA.

terms.title: Ukusebenzisa i-application
terms.body: I-AWA inikeza amathuluzi okulandelela nokuphila kahle komuntu siqu. Okuqukethwe kokugcina okuchaza amalungelo nezibopho zabasebenzisi kuzongezwa uma ukuqinisekiswa komthetho sekuphelile.

terms.title: Ukutholakala kwenkonzo
terms.body: Imigomo yokugcina elawula ukutholakala, ukulungiswa nokuguquka kwenkonzo isazoqinisekiswa.

terms.title: Xhumana
terms.body: Imininingwane esemthethweni yokuxhumana izongezwa uma iqinisekiswe yithimba le-AWA.

privacy.title: Idatha ehlobene
privacy.body: Lesi sigaba sizochaza ngokucacile idatha ehlelwa yi-AWA nenhloso yayo, uma ukuqinisekiswa komthetho sekuphelile.

privacy.title: Ukugcinwa nokuphepha
privacy.body: Imibhalo yokugcina izobeka ngokucacile izindlela zokugcina, izivikelo nezikhathi zokugcinwa.

privacy.title: Amalungelo akho
privacy.body: Izinqubo zokufinyelela, ukulungisa noma ukususa idatha yakho zizochazwa kabanzi enguqulweni eqinisekisiwe.

privacy.title: Ukuxhumana ngobumfihlo
privacy.body: Ikheli lokuxhumana elisemthethweni lesikhulu sobumfihlo lizongezwa ngaphambi kokushicilelwa.
